purpose: User-approved third retrieval method, added after the original two-method experiment.
formula: score(q,d) = sum over distinct query terms t: log(1+(N-df(t)+0.5)/(df(t)+0.5)) * tf(t,d)*(k1+1)/(tf(t,d)+k1*(1-b+b*len(d)/avglen))
reference_note: Uses the positive log1p IDF convention. This is not a claim of byte-identical Lucene scoring or Lucene's default k1.
limitations: An extension on an already-used test collection, not a newly collected independent test.
AI-reviewed relevance labels remain unchanged and are not human-validated.
No claim that BM25 must outperform TF-IDF or semantic search.
